- When the player is aligned with a block, the path connects to that block.
- Pressing LEFT/RIGHT disconnects the path (path cells turn to 'c').
- Pressing RIGHT moves the player down to the next block.
- Pressing LEFT disconnects the path but doesn't move the player.
This is very different from what I thought earlier. Let me reconsider.
Actually, wait. Earlier I successfully moved blue from 24 to 30 by pressing RIGHT 6 times. Let me check the history to see what happened.
Looking at the earlier transitions, when I pressed RIGHT to push blue, the blocks moved. But now, pressing RIGHT moves the player, not the block.
The difference might be that earlier, the path was connected to blue, and pressing RIGHT moved blue. But now, the path is not connected, and pressing RIGHT moves the player.
Let me try to reconnect the path to green and then try moving it.
Actually, let me first undo the LEFT action to reconnect the path, then try pressing RIGHT to see if green moves.
